definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines variable-occurrence data item as 'A table element that is repeated a variable number of times'; 2023 no longer defines it but uses it in the same words. In 2002 only an OCCURS DEPENDING table is such an item (2023's dynamic-capacity tables are a widening, already noted), so the rule reaches the same 2002 data; the ODO arm is shown at --std 2002 by pb393_initialize_odo_group and the CD-record probe init-cd.cob.
